name: python-email-mcp
description: Email management through IMAP and SMTP, with an MCP server, CLI, and reusable Agent Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Safely search, read, download, send, and reply to email.
interface.longDescription: A cross-platform email assistant with an IMAP/SMTP MCP server, external per-user configuration, and confirmation rules for actions that write files or send messages.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my email account is configured, then show recent messages.
Search my inbox for a subject and summarize the matching messages.
Draft an email and show me the complete preview before sending it.
